lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in multiple vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs, creating visible anchor nodes in a grid pattern across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high luminance on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.
